questions.question: What relationship does Box<T> preserve?
options: The type accepted by set is the type returned by get
questions.explanation: One type argument consistently replaces T across the class API.

questions.question: Why is Box<int> illegal?
options: Generic type arguments must be reference types; use Integer
questions.explanation: Wrappers bridge primitive values into generic APIs.

questions.question: What danger does a raw Box restore?
options: Unchecked operations and possible runtime cast failure
questions.explanation: A raw type discards the type relationship that generics provide.

questions.question: Unboxing a null Integer produces…
questions.explanation: No wrapper object exists from which to retrieve an int.
